== deinterlace-yadif=send_field
(no invocation)
error: deinterlace "yadif=send_field" emits one frame per FIELD, which would double the output's frame count: refusing to encode. Packet-count parity and duration parity are graded against the SOURCE's frame count, so such an output could only be accepted by weakening a gate that stands in front of the deletion of a source

== container-xyz
(no invocation)
error: no output container is known for the extension "xyz" (output <out>/film.xyz), so nothing was encoded: every encode names the container it writes, and this build knows ffmpeg's own choice only for 3g2, 3gp, asf, avi, flv, m2t, m2ts, m4v, mkv, mov, mp4, mpeg, mpg, mts, ogv, ts, vob, webm, wmv - set container_ext to one of those, or take the extension out of video_exts
